event_name: Rat cleanup in the wizard's tower basement
outcomes: The party survived the fight and finished clearing the remaining rats in the Wizard's Tower basement.
They also handled a Giant Flaming Spider, a Giant Centipede that crawled out of the well, and a rat that was not about to mutate.
The basement was cleared as part of the aftermath of the Session 1 giant-rat battle.
evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md

event_name: Loot recovered from the basement and well
outcomes: The group found a sack of gems.
They recovered mystery potions from corpses in the well.
They came away with additional loot from the cleared basement.
evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md

outcomes: The party bashed down a wall to reveal a hidden room.
The hidden room contained healing potions and alchemical tools and ingredients of ancient and incredible design.
The group did not yet know how to use the alchemical supplies.
evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md

event_name: Negotiation with Glowkindle over the alchemy room
outcomes: The party negotiated with Glowkindle for the right to stash gear in the hidden alchemy room.
They established that the room was not part of the original contract, and neither was the rest of the place.
Glowkindle agreed to let them use the hidden alchemy room as storage.
evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md

outcomes: The group made 25 gp each from the job.
They received a bit of loot in addition to the cash payout.
The cleanup of the basement proved financially worthwhile.
evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md

outcomes: After the job, the group decided to stick together.
They agreed to see where the winds take them next.
The party left their immediate next move open-ended.
evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 2 - Finishing the Job.md
